measurement_methodology.scope: Current real-repository canonical read-set measurement; not a reconstruction of historical model token counts, timing, or chat behavior.
measurement_methodology.start_rule: Start at exact owner/repo plus task path on the current target branch tip; resolve that mutable ref, then read immutable task/report/review blobs and pinned skill entrypoints.
measurement_methodology.routing_closure_rule_observed: The broad intake proxy closes routing after task, all task-declared execution skill entrypoints, and architect role entrypoint have been read; report/review are read after closure.
measurement_methodology.routing_closure_rule_minimal: The post-hoc projection closes routing after task artifact and exact pinned executor/SKILL.md are read; task authority already carries target, capability, and positive owner/path boundary.
measurement_methodology.byte_measurement: Raw Git blob bytes from exact immutable revisions via git show; no newline normalization, token estimate, or timing proxy.
measurement_methodology.routing_artifact_definition: Artifacts in observed_trace.read_order_before_routing_closure; post-routing artifacts are excluded from observed routing cost.
measurement_methodology.unnecessary_read_definition: Pre-closure artifacts whose routing_classification is unnecessary_to_routing_decision.
measurement_methodology.percentile_method: Nearest-rank: sorted values, rank=ceil(p*n), one-indexed; p50 is median and p75 is the 75th percentile.
measurement_methodology.support_repository_definition: Distinct exact repository identities represented by pre-closure artifact reads; target and agent-skills owner are counted, unrelated repositories are not preloaded.

corpus_selection.eligibility: Task/report/review all exist at exact current canonical tip and review/report state is reconstructible; ACCEPTED, BLOCKED, REVISION_REQUIRED, REVIEWED, and REVERIFY_REQUIRED outcomes remain eligible.
corpus_selection.elite_drive_rule: Choose lexicographically smallest eligible elite-drive episode using normalized repository name and numeric task id.
corpus_selection.remaining_rule: After mandatory anchors and elite-drive selection, sort eligible pool by normalized repository name (case-folded), numeric task id, repository, task id; take first five not already selected.

patterns.description: Task-declared non-executor skill entrypoints were read before routing closure even though the minimal projection needs only executor/SKILL.md for routing.
architect/SKILL.md was preloaded as a role-boundary cross-check although pinned executor/SKILL.md already owns Executor routing and no selected task required architect execution.

recurring_capability_sets.comparison_basis: Exact task-declared capability names; recurrence is measured across independent episodes. Repository diversity is recorded separately. Exact-set differences are material when they add or remove a required execution surface. No CASE key or taxonomy is defined.

admission_evidence.decision_boundary: PROVEN is only a mechanical evidence result under CR-00's three gates; it is not the Architect's final admission decision.

embedding_admission_observation.basis: All projected reads are exact canonical paths and this run performed no semantic retrieval. The observation does not admit embeddings, vectors, indexes, or retrieval machinery.

scope_and_authority_proof.semantic_authority_owner: Existing task, pinned agent-skills entrypoints, and each target repository's existing canonical owners remain authoritative.
